Container.Name: joplin-mcp
Container.Overview: Joplin MCP Server (Streamable HTTP). Bridge to a Joplin Desktop Web Clipper API on another host. Point MCP clients at http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/mcp.

Config.Name: JOPLIN_READ_ONLY
Config.Description: true disables every write tool (create/update/delete/tag/import), leaving only search_notes, get_note, list_tags, get_note_tags. Set this while the endpoint is reachable without authentication.

Config.Name: JOPLIN_IMPORT_ROOT
Config.Description: Directory import_markdown may read from. Leave EMPTY to remove the tool. Unconfined it reads any file in the container, including /proc/self/environ, which contains JOPLIN_TOKEN.

Config.Name: JOPLIN_ALLOW_PERMANENT_DELETE
Config.Description: true allows delete_note(permanent=true), which bypasses the Joplin trash and cannot be undone. Leave false; normal deletes still work and stay recoverable.

Config.Name: MCP_OAUTH_ENABLED
Config.Description: Require OAuth 2.1 bearer tokens on /mcp. This endpoint is published to the internet, so set this to true once the Authelia client exists. While it is false, anyone who finds the URL has full use of the Joplin token.

Config.Name: MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER
Config.Description: OIDC issuer, byte for byte as the provider reports it at /.well-known/openid-configuration. Authelia reports a bare origin with no trailing slash.

Config.Name: MCP_SERVER_URL
Config.Description: Public base URL, no path. The connector URL is this plus /mcp, and that combined string must match what you enter in Claude exactly.

Config.Name: MCP_READ_GROUPS
Config.Description: Comma-separated Authelia groups granted read tools only (search_notes, get_note, list_tags, get_note_tags). Leave both group lists empty to let any valid token use every exposed tool.

Config.Name: MCP_WRITE_GROUPS
Config.Description: Comma-separated Authelia groups granted every exposed tool, including delete_note.

Config.Name: MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE
Config.Description: Expected aud claim. Leave EMPTY until the flow works end to end - an audience mismatch produces a blanket 401 that looks like every other failure.
